text: {"standards":[{"code":"RL.6.1","verdict":"taught","reason":"In the Part A close read, students star Percy's choices, underline feelings, and cite specific lines from pp. 158–167 to explain what they reveal about him."},{"code":"RL.6.5","verdict":"taught","reason":"The Part A Think-Pair-Share on how the bus fight raises the stakes has students explain how the episode fits the quest's series of challenges and moves the plot forward."},{"code":"RL.6.7","verdict":"taught","reason":"Part B has students compare the book scene with the 2010 film in a two-column organizer and write notes contrasting what they see and hear when reading versus watching."},{"code":"L.6.4","verdict":"taught","reason":"In the Vocabulary in Context activity, students use sentence clues to determine meanings of words like careened and delicacy and write their own meanings in a Personal Dictionary."},{"code":"L.6.5","verdict":"partly","reason":"The Vocabulary in Context activity covers word relationships and connotation (hideous vs. eerily, careened vs. drove), but no activity addresses figurative language."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"uses","reason":"The lesson's activities explicitly direct students to The Lightning Thief pp. 158–167 for reading, vocabulary, fluency, and the book-versus-film comparison."}}
